newsitem.title: JAPAN: Key JGB futures end unchanged from previous day.
newsitem.headline: Key JGB futures end unchanged from previous day.

text.p: Key December Japanese government bond futures ended unchanged on Wednesday after recouping earlier losses in a market that lacked fresh factors.

The December was sold earlier in the day and fell as low as 122.02 as the yen weakened versus the dollar in Tokyo, but was later bought back when the yen failed to weaken to 112.00 to the dollar by the close of trade in JGB futures at 0600 GMT, traders said.
"JGBs seemed to be rising on short-covering, after traders saw few follow-through sales were taking place," said a trader for a trust bank's securities affiliate.
